craft_notes: Sthāyin: yāmala gate — abheda proclaimed. Rows: definition lands first; disregard follows. Rejected: softening loketara — killed: transgressive is the doctrine. Read aloud: gate-swing.

lines: Now the pair. Hear the Śakti's sign: even so — no-two.
Set age and birth and all aside, hold nothing dear:
they are one who are born of the world-defying wed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atha yāmale śakter lakṣaṇam etat tadvad abhedas tato 'napekṣya vayaḥ jātyādīṃś cāsaṅgāt loketarayugalajaṃ hi tādātmyam
